title: Pentaryn Dice
description: Dice So Nice persistent dice, made easier for big physical-style rolls: a count box on each die in the Dice So Nice tab ("+ ×8" puts 8d6 on the table in one click), Select all mine, Select all of one type, Clear selection, the Ctrl+click hint shown inline, and Alt+A to select all your dice (rebindable; not Ctrl+A, which selects tokens). Per-client; drives Dice So Nice's own persistent-dice state and writes nothing of its own. Exposes game.pentaryn.dice.

requires.reason: Every helper drives Dice So Nice's persistent dice (game.dice3d.persistent, the box's persistentDiceManager) and its sidebar tab.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Dice' (core.moduleConfiguration["pentaryn-dice"] = true), then reload.
game.pentaryn.dice.selftest()   // the six Dice So Nice internals; needs DSN's persistent dice setting on
